import asyncio
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, Mock
from kubernetes_asyncio.watch import Watch
async def main():
    fake_resp = AsyncMock()
    fake_resp.content.readline = AsyncMock(side_effect=[b'log_line_1', b'',
        AssertionError('readline called after end-of-log: reconnect loop')])
    fake_resp.release = Mock()
    fake_api = Mock()
    fake_api.read_namespaced_pod_log = AsyncMock(return_value=fake_resp)

    w = Watch()

        async for e in w.stream(fake_api.read_namespaced_pod_log):
            seq.append(e)
    print('log_sequence', seq)
    assert seq == ['log_line_1'], seq
asyncio.run(main())
